description: This file defines the CatalogContext class, which inherits from Entity Framework's DbContext and provides DbSet properties for various entities such as Baskets, CatalogItems, Orders, and OrderItems. It configures the model by applying entity configurations from the assembly.

classes.name: CatalogContext
classes.description: Entity Framework DbContext for accessing catalog-related data, including baskets, catalog items, brands, types, orders, and order items.

methods.name: CatalogContext
methods.description: Constructor accepting DbContextOptions, initializing the DbContext.

methods.name: OnModelCreating
methods.description: Overrides the base method to apply entity configurations from the current assembly.
